double_count_test.meaning: The venue's realizedPnl is pure settlement cashflow (payout - cost_basis), carrying no rebate and no fee, so credits are additive to it rather than already inside it. A failure here means the venue changed that and the bridge would double-count; it refuses instead.

rewards.note: Only a status the venue uses for money paid counts. An unrecognised status is an accrual until it is understood, never income.

non_trading.note: Held OUT of the bridge on purpose: it is in the balance and it is not trading income.
